mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, John Ehlers' canonical Cyber Cycle crossing its one-bar trigger on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a filtered cyclical turn; follow the new cycle direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when Cycle crosses strictly above its one-bar-lagged trigger; short on the strict reverse crossover
mechanism.why_distinct: Cyber Cycle applies a symmetric 1-2-2-1 median-price smoother and a recursive second-order high-pass cycle filter before crossing the cycle against its lag. It is not a price-average crossover, normalized sinewave, fixed return oscillator, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse recursive cycle-versus-trigger turns are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.initialization: within each uninterrupted source run, observations before index 7 use (price-2*price_lag1+price_lag2)/4 when available; require seven uninterrupted observations before source validity
features.event: current Cycle-minus-trigger strict nonzero sign differs from its immediately prior finite nonzero sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Ehlers alpha-0.07 Cyber Cycle/one-bar-trigger crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no alpha, input, initialization, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers, Cybernetic Analysis for Stocks and Futures, Cyber Cycle
external_basis.fixed_definition: median price; 1-2-2-1 smoothing; alpha=0.07 recursive Cyber Cycle; first six observations use the published finite-difference initialization; trigger is Cycle lagged one bar; line crossover
external_basis.selection_use: published alpha, formula, initialization, trigger, and crossover direction only; no incidence or outcomes
